title: UCB EE16A&B: Designing Information Devices and Systems I&II

unit.title: From ADC Counts to a Tested Sensor Pipeline
unit.scope: A simulation-only introduction to voltage dividers, ADC conversion, rolling-median filtering, defensive CSV handling, deterministic command-line behavior, and automated Python tests.
learning_outcomes: Translate an ideal voltage-divider model into a numerically guarded conversion pipeline.
State and enforce input, configuration, and output contracts at software boundaries.
Implement and test a deterministic trailing-median sensor-data transformation.
Prevent invalid input from partially replacing a previously valid output artifact.
Explain what the implementation demonstrates and what cannot be inferred from catalog links.
out_of_scope: coverage of the full EE16A or EE16B syllabus
claims of equivalence to a UC Berkeley assignment

unit_success_requires: the learner submission contains the implementation, documentation, tests, and separate comprehension responses required by STUDY_TASK.md
the implementation passes its own deterministic test suite in a clean supported Python environment
an independent worker-harness-controlled validator checks the observable contract and records evidence
an examiner evaluates the comprehension responses independently using examiner_only/RUBRIC.md
completion_policy.promotion_authority: Only a validator controlled by the worker harness may promote this unit to SUCCEEDED.
completion_policy.whole_course_rule: This kickoff can establish completion of only kickoff_unit_001_sensor_pipeline. Whole-course completion requires a later, provenance-backed graph of additional units and successful validation of every unit designated as required; that graph does not yet exist.
